meta.title: An Email for Grandpa
meta.textType: functional: an email about a birthday

paragraphs: Subject: A secret party for Grandpa. Dear Aunt Sue. I write this email on Mom's laptop in the dining room. I want to invite you to Grandpa's birthday party. He is seventy-one years old on the twenty-second of November. The party is in our house on Saturday, the twenty-first, at four o'clock. It's a secret, so please don't tell him. Grandpa thinks that we have a small family dinner. We love Grandpa very much. Would you like to come?

Mom wants to buy a board game for Grandpa. But I have a better idea. It is a big day for us. Grandpa likes old photos, so I want you to bring one. Please find a photo of Grandpa and Grandma. Tom and I go shopping on Friday to buy a book. We clean the room after that, and Dad cooks. Tom says, "I want to make a big cake." His cake is big, but it is not easy to make. Mom invites twenty people to the party. She asks them to come at three o'clock, before Grandpa. Can you change your work days at the hospital? I put a red circle on the calendar.

Are you surprised by this email? Mom says that you always say yes. Please write to me today, and I can tell Mom. I think that you can come. We miss you! Thank you, Aunt Sue. Love and a big hug from Lily.
